paragraphs.source_en: Then o’er the stubble up the mountain flies,

units.source_en: Then o’er the stubble up the mountain flies,

paragraphs.source_en: Fires the high woods, and blazes to the skies,

units.source_en: Fires the high woods, and blazes to the skies,

paragraphs.source_en: This way and that, the spreading torrent roars:

units.source_en: This way and that, the spreading torrent roars:

paragraphs.source_en: So sweeps the hero through the wasted shores;

units.source_en: So sweeps the hero through the wasted shores;

paragraphs.source_en: Around him wide, immense destruction pours

units.source_en: Around him wide, immense destruction pours

paragraphs.source_en: And earth is deluged with the sanguine showers,

units.source_en: And earth is deluged with the sanguine showers,

paragraphs.source_en: As with autumnal harvests cover’d o’er,

units.source_en: As with autumnal harvests cover’d o’er,

paragraphs.source_en: And thick bestrewn, lies Ceres’ sacred floor;

units.source_en: And thick bestrewn, lies Ceres’ sacred floor;

paragraphs.source_en: When round and round, with never-wearied pain,

units.source_en: When round and round, with never-wearied pain,

paragraphs.source_en: The trampling steers beat out the unnumber’d grain:

units.source_en: The trampling steers beat out the unnumber’d grain:

paragraphs.source_en: So the fierce coursers, as the chariot rolls,

units.source_en: So the fierce coursers, as the chariot rolls,

paragraphs.source_en: Tread down whole ranks, and crush out heroes’ souls,

units.source_en: Tread down whole ranks, and crush out heroes’ souls,

paragraphs.source_en: Dash’d from their hoofs while o’er the dead they fly,

units.source_en: Dash’d from their hoofs while o’er the dead they fly,

paragraphs.source_en: Black, bloody drops the smoking chariot dye:

units.source_en: Black, bloody drops the smoking chariot dye:

paragraphs.source_en: The spiky wheels through heaps of carnage tore;

units.source_en: The spiky wheels through heaps of carnage tore;

paragraphs.source_en: And thick the groaning axles dropp’d with gore.

units.source_en: And thick the groaning axles dropp’d with gore.

paragraphs.source_en: High o’er the scene of death Achilles stood,

units.source_en: High o’er the scene of death Achilles stood,

paragraphs.source_en: All grim with dust, all horrible in blood:

units.source_en: All grim with dust, all horrible in blood:

paragraphs.source_en: Yet still insatiate, still with rage on flame;

units.source_en: Yet still insatiate, still with rage on flame;

paragraphs.source_en: Such is the lust of never-dying fame!

units.source_en: Such is the lust of never-dying fame!
